paths.title: Capture useful context
paths.question: What should people record and label?
paths.decision: Reuse annotation workflows and independent behavior labels. Make unknowns explicit.
paths.next_step: A synthetic file-exchange check, followed by a species-specific codebook and a reviewer-agreement exercise on approved data.
paths.gate: Real observations require an approved protocol, rights and consent. Public clips are not automatically research data.

paths.title: Find sounds worth reviewing
paths.question: How do we detect events without missing the quiet ones?
paths.decision: Compare existing detectors and encoders against our simple sound-level trigger. Keep a continuous, independently annotated test sample.
paths.next_step: Freeze a small permitted evaluation set and measure event recall, false alarms per hour and human review time.
paths.gate: Triggered clips alone cannot establish recall. Specialized recorders do not establish phone performance.

paths.title: Reuse models, then test transfer
paths.question: Can sound help predict independently observed context?
paths.decision: Start with frozen audio features and a small classifier. Compare against context-only, background and simple acoustic baselines.
paths.next_step: Pin one checkpoint and dataset version, review their separate rights and pretraining overlap, and freeze splits by animal and session before evaluation.
paths.gate: No Talk2Nature animal model has been trained or benchmarked. Language-like output is not verified meaning.

paths.title: Know what would count as understanding
paths.question: When does an association support a claim about meaning?
paths.decision: Study receiver behavior, matched comparisons and competing explanations. Keep new critiques connected to the original paper.
paths.next_step: Ask a scientific reviewer to assess one bounded hypothesis and its controls before designing any intervention.
paths.gate: Public tools remain passive. No automated playback or general translation claim.

paths.title: Connect sound, movement and other signals
paths.question: Which measurements could reveal something audio alone misses?
paths.decision: Use separate evidence standards for animal behavior, plant physiology and fungal electrophysiology.
paths.next_step: Test the notebook workflow now; recruit scientific review for one passive audio-video protocol before expanding sensors.
paths.gate: Current public apps do not capture video, identify species or upload data. Plant ultrasound and fungal electricity need suitable hardware.
